$comment: DirectDraw/Direct3D compatibility matrix for original GTA2 10.5 on EC2 G4dn. Registry semantics verified against CriminalRETeam/gta2_re Source/winmain.cpp: start_mode 0=windowed, 1=fullscreen (windowed silently falls back to fullscreen and rewrites start_mode=1); fullscreen is 640x480 by default at 16 bpp; render/video DLLs are hard-coded to d3ddll.dll + dmavideo.dll in 10.5. Verified 2026-10-13 on g4dn.xlarge with GRID 596.86 (WDDM): 9.6 renders the frontend with ddrawcompat-* (PASS); native fails with Videomode 16x16x16 is not available.

game.$comment: GTA 2 9.6 (Rockstar Classics) - standalone gta2.exe. The 10.5 Freeloader binary (freeloader.dat as gta2.exe, sha256 2443197...ccb3 archive) fails to start on Windows Server 2022 with 0xc0000022 (seen 2026-10-13), it expects its Freeloader launcher.

input.$comment: How capture mode injects keys: scancode (SendInput + KEYEVENTF_SCANCODE), vk (SendInput virtual key + scan code), postmessage (WM_KEYDOWN/UP to the game window), activate-scancode (attach to the game's input thread, focus, then scancode) focusmsg-scancode (WM_ACTIVATE + WM_SETFOCUS to the game window, then scancode) or cycle (key i uses method i mod 5, for diagnosis). 2026-10-13: scancode did not change the 9.6 frontend under DDrawCompat (run local-20261013-084136); cycle is set TEMPORARILY for one diagnosis run, then the working method becomes the default.

driver.$comment: Tried in order. grid-public = AWS GRID driver for G4dn (WDDM + Direct3D on the T4; licensed for AWS instances), anonymous HTTPS download of the public object in s3://ec2-windows-nvidia-drivers/latest (SCP-free: no signed API call), pinned key + SHA-256 + NVIDIA Authenticode. Verified 2026-10-13: 596.86 installs and the T4 runs in WDDM. url = NVIDIA data center driver 581.80 - installs but REFUSES WDDM (nvidia-smi -dm 0: Not Supported), so Direct3D falls back to the Basic Display Adapter; kept as fallback. grid-s3 = signed S3 access, denied by the project SCP.

ddrawcompat-exclusive.$comment: DDrawCompat with real exclusive fullscreen instead of its borderless presentation window (input focus diagnosis 2026-10-13).

cases.$comment: Hypothesis: with Basic Display + T4 present, device index 2 may select the NVIDIA adapter.
